div.head: EGu 4.2
div.ab: ⁊ gyf gehadod man hine forwyrce mid deaðscylde, gewylde hine man ⁊ healde to bisceopes dome.
Gif gehadod man hine forwyrce mid deaþscylde, gewilde hine man ⁊ healde to bisceopes dome.
Et si ordinatus homo se forisfaciat in morte puniendis (plectendis) actibus, exsuperetur et episcopi iudicio reseruetur.
Gif gehadod man hine forwyrce mid deaþscylde, gewilde hine man ⁊ healde to bisceopes dome.
Gif gehadod man hine forwyrce mid deaþscylde, gewilde hine man and healde to bisceopes dome.
If a man in orders places his life in jeopardy by committing a capital crime, he shall be arrested, and his case shall be reserved for the bishop's decision.
If a man in orders compromises himself with a capital crime, he is to be arrested and held for the bishop’s judgment.
Wenn ein geweihter Mann sich [sein Leben] verwirkt durch Todes [würdige] Schuld, ergreife und bewahre man ihn für des Bischofs Urtheilspruch.
If an ordained man forfeits [his life] by a crime [deserving] death, let him be seized and kept for the bishop’s judgment.
